sources.title: Planning obligations
sources.facts: Explains that plans should address education contributions using pupil yields, capacity and temporary or permanent needs.
sources.guard: National guidance does not prove a site's pupil yield, contribution liability, agreement, payment or school delivery.

sources.title: Basic need allocations
sources.facts: Publishes local-authority capital funding and methodology for creating school places needed through 2028.
sources.guard: An allocation does not prove a particular school, site, expansion, timetable or amount is approved or delivered.

sources.title: School capital funding
sources.facts: Explains condition and improvement funding, eligibility, allocations and permitted spending for school estates.
sources.guard: Funding guidance does not prove an institution is eligible, awarded funds, compliant or able to deliver works.

sources.title: High needs provision capital allocations: explanatory note
sources.facts: Explains allocations supporting places for pupils with SEND and those requiring alternative provision.
sources.guard: Allocation methodology does not prove local demand, site selection, provider approval, construction or opening.

sources.title: School capacity survey: guide for local authorities
sources.facts: Sets the annual SCAP collection timetable and links current capacity, forecast and planning-area guidance.
sources.guard: A survey return or collection process does not prove future demand, actual deliverability or funding.

sources.title: School capacity survey 2026: guide for local authorities
sources.facts: Defines schools, capacities, forecasts and submission requirements for the statutory 2026 collection.
sources.guard: Submitted or published capacity data may have timing, forecast and definition limits and is not a site approval.

sources.title: Local authority pupil planning areas: guidance
sources.facts: Sets expectations for structuring planning areas so school-place need is accurately reflected in SCAP data.
sources.guard: Planning-area structure does not prove exact catchments, admissions, pupil numbers, land need or delivery.

sources.title: School organisation
sources.facts: Collects 2026 guidance on opening, closing and significantly changing maintained schools and academies.
sources.guard: A statutory process collection does not prove consultation, approval, funding, site suitability or school opening.
